warnings: All DOBs supplied from 2017-18 season FootballSquads player rosters; independently crosschecking every date against a second source remains pending.
All exact individual PL starts and appearances unverified and stored null, not zero.
Only select league scoring / De Bruyne assist totals independently supported; most goals/assists remain null.
Burnley flat-midfield roles Cork (DM nominal) and Defour (CM), Hendrick supporting ST (CAM); Burnley role mapping approximate.
Man U Rashford LW/RW/ST, Arsenal Mkhitaryan RW/CAM, Chelsea wingbacks and Spurs Eriksen RW/CAM, Liverpool Henderson/Can DM/CM season majority needs match-level census.
Backup eligibility of Romero, Carrick, Ibrahimović, Vorm and others must be reviewed against actual PL starts; limited rotation not automatic eligibility.

Alexis Sánchez made 2017-18 league appearances for Arsenal and Manchester United; retained once, on Arsenal side with more season starts. United short stint excluded from candidate table to prevent duplicate physical player and same-season split duplication.
Short-start or cup-first backups Romero, Carrick, Ibrahimović and Fernando Llorente removed rather than using them to fill a positional candidate quota.
Manchester United Juan Mata classified RW and Marcus Rashford classified LW (not forced to RW); independent match-start role census pending.
Position cap leaves some eligible rotation candidates unlisted, especially at wide attacking positions. No athlete represented twice.
